fee_notes: Royalty is 2-10% of Net Revenue (up to 11% for Co-Branding Shop franchises in certain SpeeDee DMAs). Tiered reduced rates apply: tires/tire-related at 6%, batteries at 2%, Exempt Sales at 0%, standard rate is 10%. Fleet Amendment reduces royalty to 4% (Qualifying National Fleet) or 7% (Qualifying Local Fleet). New Franchisee royalty reductions: 60% reduction months 1-12, 40% reduction months 13-24. Existing Franchisee opening new shop: 80% reduction months 1-12, 60% reduction months 13-24, 40% reduction months 25-36. Marketing/advertising is funded by franchisor expending not less than one-half of royalties received on marketing costs (no separate percentage fee charged to franchisee). Warranty Registration Fees: brake pads/shoes $2.43/axle, mufflers $4.80 each, shocks/struts $1.04 each, missing/unknown parts $2.43 each. Midas Limited Lifetime Tire Guarantee Fee: $1.60/qualifying tire sold. Transfer Fee: greater of $5,000 or 15% of initial franchise fee (for FA dated April 1, 2010 or after); 0.5% of sales price (for FA dated before April 1, 2010); capped at $1,250/shop after first shop in simultaneous multi-shop transfer. New Franchisee Support Fee (on Transfer): initial franchise fee less transfer fee paid. Resale Assistance Fee: up to $15,000. Relocation Fee: $1,000. Renewal Fee: currently $5,000 (up to maximum $17,500). Audit Fee: cost of audit plus additional royalties if understatement >5% of Net Revenues. Interest on late royalty: lesser of 18%/year or max allowed by law. Late charge for electronic submission of monthly sales report: $20/month. Fee for manually completing monthly sales report: currently $100, up to $500. Fleet Program Processing Fee: 1.25% of sales transaction plus $0.95 per transaction. E-mail account: currently none, may charge up to $100/month. Liquidated damages: $300/day. Sales/Volume Growth Royalty Incentive rebate: 0.15%-0.40% of royalties as credit for shops with $1.5M+ annual Net Revenues meeting qualification criteria.

Royalty 2-10% of Net Revenue; up to 11% in certain cases for a Co-Branding Shop franchise - see Note A | Payable on the 10th of each month via ACH debit - see Note B | Net Revenue includes all revenue from the Franchised Unit, exclusive of sales, use or gross receipts taxes.
Marketing / Advertising - see Note A - see Note A
Warranty Registration Fee: Brake pads or shoes: $2.43 per axle; Mufflers: $4.80 each; Shocks and Struts: $1.04 each; Missing/Unknown Parts: $2.43 each
Midas Limited Lifetime Tire Guarantee Fees: $1.60 per qualifying tire sold
Rent, Taxes & Insurance: fixed minimum rent ($5,000 - $20,000 per month) or in certain limited circumstances, 7% or greater of Gross Sales
Transfer Fee: greater of (a) $5,000 or (b) 15% of the initial franchise fee (for FA dated April 1, 2010 or after); 0.5% of sales price (for FA dated before April 1, 2010); capped at $1,250/shop after first in simultaneous transfer
New Franchisee Support Fee (on Transfer): equal to initial franchise fee less transfer fee paid
Resale Assistance Fee: up to $15,000
Relocation Fee: $1,000
Renewal Fee: currently $5,000 (up to $17,500)
Audit Fee: cost of audit plus additional royalties if understatement >5%
Interest Charge on Late Royalty Payments: lesser of 18% per year or max allowed by law
Late Charge on Electronic Submission of Monthly Sales Report: $20 per month
Fee for Manually completing Monthly Sales Report: currently $100, up to $500
Fleet Program Processing Fee: 1.25% of sales transaction plus $0.95 per transaction
E-mail Account: currently none, may charge up to $100/month
Liquidated Damages: $300/day
Indemnification: actual losses
Insurance: actual cost of replacement insurance
